message: The other day, my kids were convinced they could make dinner without me, so I let them have a go while I kept an eye from the living room. Suddenly, I sniffed something burning and dashed to the kitchen just in time to save their ‘masterpiece’ from becoming a mini-disaster. 😅 It reminded me that while I want them to be independent, we still need a fire escape plan in place. Sometimes, it’s all about finding that balance between letting them explore and ensuring we’re prepared. How do you keep the kitchen safe while letting the kids have fun?
